author: Noema III
title: DSConv-PM v7 — Dilated + attention pooling with dataset-aware reverse (CRI-Off OFF)
abstract: Combines a dilated depthwise-separable conv backbone with power-mean pooling and a lightweight attention pooling head (for classification). Reverse augmentation and bi-reverse eval are disabled only for CRI-Off; enabled elsewhere.
